messages:
maria: Heads up — a customer just flagged an apparent double charge on a streamed completion that hit a reconnect + replay path. They say tokens 0..420 billed twice even though final ack only covers 0..420 once. logs pasted below. :grimacing:

jen: ouch. any repro steps or trace id?

maria: Trace id in logs: rt-9c2b. snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T12:10:05Z] session=session-7 seq=0 send_fragment=len=256 offset=0
[2026-03-18T12:10:06Z] conn=drop reconnect session=session-7 new_conn=conn-b seq_resume=128
[2026-03-18T12:10:06Z] replayer=session-7 replay_fragment=len=128 offset=128 replay=true
[2026-03-18T12:10:07Z] toolcall=invoke id=tool-translate tokens_consumed=200 ack_offset=420
[2026-03-18T12:10:07Z] billing: provisional_charge session=session-7 amount_tokens=420
[2026-03-18T12:10:08Z] billing: final_charge session=session-7 amount_tokens=420
```

maria: Looks like provisional ran at replay time and final ran after toolcall ack, but there was no dedupe because provisional and final used different IDs.

tariq: Is this the stream->toolcall path where we instrument both fragments and toolcall events separately? We treat provisional as optimistic charge and then convert to final. If the provisional landed on the old connection and final on a new runtime, our ledger dedupe currently keys on runtime+session_id, so it wouldn't catch cross-runtime duplicates.

jen: yup. we have a few levers: 1) use a global id for provisional->final (attach a charge_id to the session so it survives reconnects), 2) expand dedupe key to include session-level id only (not runtime), 3) conservative fix: mark provisionals as provisional and auto-credit if duplicate final seen within 30s.

maria: Customer impact: they saw a ~2x token bill for that request. They want credits and a fix. Ops needs a short-term reconciliation step.

tariq: short-term we can add a reconcile job that looks for pairs: provisional + final with same ack_offset and same session fingerprint within last 24h and auto-issue credit. I can spin that up quickly.

jen: long-term I prefer global charge_id attached to the session event stream. e.g., when we create a provisional charge we emit charge_id=<uuid> in the stream metadata and propagate it into subsequent final events. then ledger dedupe uses charge_id.

maria: Agree on charge_id. Also console UX change: show "provisional" vs "final" charges and let customers filter on provisional so they can see what might be auto-reconciled. Right now billing dashboard shows both as normal charges which scares customers.

tariq: Telemetry: add tags to spans: replay=true, ack_offset, charge_id. That will help queries. Also we should log reconnect_reason and old_runtime/new_runtime to detect cross-runtime handoffs.

jen: Implementation note — toolcall path sometimes synthesizes a new ack_offset because of suffix trimming; we need to ensure the canonical ack_offset used for dedupe is the post-truncation canonicalized offset. Add a deterministic normalizer before comparing.

opsbot: @channel Created ticket BILL-1134 for customer credit reconciliation. Owner: tariq. ETA: 48h for reconcile job; 2w for design + rollout of charge_id dedupe.

maria: For the reconcile job, can we log what we'd credit before issuing? want a manual approval checkbox for >$500 credits.

tariq: yes, reconcile will produce a dry-run report first. manual approve to apply large credits. small ones (<$50) can be auto-applied.

jen: One more edge: clients that do optimistic local truncation (client stops sending rest but server still had fragments) — we must ensure our prefix capture uses server-observed offsets, not client-specified. Otherwise ack_offset mismatch will prevent dedupe.

maria: Agreed. I'll update the incident notes and draft a short help center blurb about provisional charges and how we reconcile streaming retries.

invoicer-bot: Invoice notice: Customer xyz credited $0.00 yet. ACTION: follow-up required.

maria: Thanks. tariq, can you post a short runbook for on-call so they know when to escalate billing disputes vs ops reconciliation? :thumbsup:

tariq: will do — posting runbook in #help once ticket BILL-1134 has the reconcile run attached.

jen: quick PR ideas: (a) add charge_id to streaming wire protocol (b) ledger dedupe by charge_id (c) add provisional flag to billing UI. I'll open PRs for (a)/(b) tomorrow.

maria: Cool. For now, customer-facing: credit + explainer + ETA on permanent fix. I'll handle comms. :sparkles:
